$comment: Store listing fields that apify push never sends. Applied by scripts/store-metadata.mjs after every deploy. Title, description and categories live in actor.json.
seoTitle: Social Analyzer - Find Social Media by Username | Sherlock
seoDescription: Find someone's social media profiles from a username, across 900+ sites. Confidence-ranked, no login or API key. Paste a handle or link, we clean it. For recruiting, fraud checks, people search.
defaultRunOptions$comment: Full-depth default (all 999 sites, 60 scanner workers, two chunks in flight) took 125 s locally; 2 GB gives CPU headroom so the daily Store test stays under 5 minutes. Timeout 3600 matches the input's one-hour maximum; 25 usernames at full depth need about 75 minutes, so the form tells users to lower the site count for big lists.

pricing.$comment: v1.1.0 moves charging from apify-default-dataset-item ($0.005 per row incl. the summary) to a custom 'profile' event at the same $0.005, charged per step as rows are delivered; the summary row becomes free. Adding an event is a model change the CI script will not automate: apply this record via API at deploy time (PUT pricingInfos, append), then the script sees a match. Event name must equal PROFILE_EVENT in src/main.py.

pricingInfos.reasonForChange: Same $0.005 per profile found, now charged step by step as rows are delivered instead of per dataset row; the summary row is free and cut-off runs pay only for what arrived.

profile.eventDescription: One profile row: platform, URL, confidence, match rate, site category and country, page title, language and meta tags. Charged as each step of the scan delivers its rows. The summary row is free.
